capabilities: Apply heading levels 1-6 or no heading to the current line
Increase or decrease headings across selected lines
Insert headings at the current, one level deeper, or one level higher
Optionally bind Tab and Shift-Tab to increase and decrease headings
Remove or retain list markers and emphasis styles when applying headings, with list outdending behavior
extras: The README warns that the optional Tab/Shift-Tab override may conflict with other plugins' Tab behavior, and documents limits (lower-limit setting, decrease stops at heading 6).
motivation: The author built it for daily rearrangement of linked files, such as cutting a section into its own file or merging one file into another, where heading levels must be adjusted in bulk.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to batch-change the # level of headings, so restructuring content when moving text between files means editing hashes line by line.
summary: Command set that applies, shifts, and inserts Markdown heading levels on the current line or selected lines.
